summary: Phase 13 (P0): Authentication & Authorization. Added email/password + JWT auth (bcrypt hashing, HS256 tokens): POST /api/auth/register, POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/auth/me. Workspaces now carry owner_id; registration creates an owned default workspace with seeded connectors. Workspace routes are ownership-guarded (GET/PUT/export -> 403 for other users). get_wid is auth-aware: foreign X-Workspace-Id headers are rejected with 403 for authenticated users, and missing headers fall back to the user's own default workspace. LLM endpoints are rate-limited per workspace (in-process sliding window, default 30/min -> 429). Staged enforcement via AUTH_REQUIRED (default false = legacy no-auth behavior; true = 401 on every /api route without a valid token). Frontend: Bearer-token interceptor, AuthContext, /login page, header sign in/out. Verified with 12 new local tests (full suite 52 passed, 2 skipped) plus live uvicorn smoke tests in grace and strict modes.
